item.title: Child Care Recovery and Stabilization Grant program
item.description:
Hello Valued Child Care and Early Learning Partner,

This pandemic has hard hit Ohio businesses and industries.  But no sector in Ohio has been quite as affected as the child care industry.

Early care and education is crucial not only for the education and development of our children, but also for our working families.  That is why developing a birth to five plan for our county is one of my main priorities.  In addition, child care providers are some of the small businesses that fuel our local economy.

It is important to me, and our entire community, that we provide direct financial support to you and other early childcare providers to maintain the critical services you provide.  That is why in August, the City partnered with Franklin County to provide $8.2 million in federal CARES funds to assist eligible child care providers.  If you are receiving this email, you most likely quality for the grant.

Please complete this simple online application to request grant dollars to support your Center: https://communityportal.fcdjfs.franklincountyohio.gov/. Follow the link for the Child Care Recovery and Stabilization Grant program.  The deadline is November 18.

If you have any questions please call either the Franklin County Department of Job and Family Services at 614-212-1822 or Action For Children at 614-224-0222.

Thank you for your service to our children and families!
